query:
insert or ignore into UsableTestCases (
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_case_name
            )
            select
                pc.product_id,
                pc.test_run_name,
                pc.test_case_name
            from PassedTestCases pc, ValidTestRuns vtr
            where pc.product_id = vtr.product_id
            and pc.test_run_name = vtr.test_run_name
